summary: A gentle lying hold that teaches you to draw the lower belly inward, building awareness and control of the deep abdominal muscles.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Find a neutral spine with a small natural curve under your lower back.
Gently draw your belly button in toward your spine without moving your hips or ribs.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Holding the breath while drawing in
Flattening the back by tilting the pelvis
Sucking in so hard the ribs flare

summary: A standing balance drill that lifts one leg out to the side to strengthen the hip abductors and steady the standing hip.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding a wall or chair lightly if needed.
Shift your weight onto one leg and brace your trunk.
Lift the other leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg under control without letting it rest.
Switch sides.
cues: Stand tall on the support leg
mistakes: Leaning the torso away from the lifting leg
Turning the toes up toward the ceiling
Swinging the leg with momentum

summary: A straight-arm hang with the shoulders actively pulled down that builds grip, lat and scapular strength for pull-ups.
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with hands about shoulder-width apart and hang with straight elbows.
Gently draw your shoulders down away from your ears without bending your arms.
Keep your legs together and your body still, with no swinging.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Relaxing into a passive hang with shrugged shoulders
Bending the elbows to pull up
Swinging or kicking the legs

summary: A kneeling mobility drill that rocks the hips back over one bent knee to stretch the inner thigh and open the hips.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg straight out to the side, foot flat and toes pointing forward.
Keeping your back flat, slowly push your hips back toward the heel of the kneeling leg.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the inner thigh, pause briefly, then rock forward.
Switch sides.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back as the hips move back
Rolling the extended foot onto its edge

summary: A single-leg hinge that tips the torso forward as the free leg lifts behind, strengthening the glutes and hamstrings and improving balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your hands on your hips or out to the sides.
Keeping your back neutral, hinge forward at the hip as the free leg lifts behind you.
Lower until your torso and back leg are close to one line, hips level.
Squeeze the glutes of the standing leg to bring yourself back up to standing.
Switch sides.
mistakes: Opening the hip so the lifted leg turns out
Rounding the back to reach lower
Locking the standing knee

summary: A straight-arm hang in which you pull the shoulder blades back and lift the chest, strengthening the upper back for pull-ups and levers.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms and shoulders drawn down into an active hang.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and back while keeping your elbows straight.
Lift your chest toward the bar and let your body arch slightly, legs together.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Bending the elbows to turn it into a pull-up
Arching only the lower back instead of the upper back
Swinging into the position

summary: A gentle upper-body stretch combining an overhead arm reach and a side neck tilt to ease tension in the shoulders, upper traps and triceps.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow, and let the hand drop behind your head.
With the other hand, gently press the bent elbow back until you feel a stretch.
Slowly tilt your head away from the raised arm, keeping both shoulders down.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

summary: An advanced straight-arm hold with the body horizontal and face down beneath the bar, building great lat, shoulder and core strength.
steps: Hang from a bar or rings and pass your legs between your arms into a skin-the-cat position.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lower your hips until your body faces the floor.
Stop when your body is horizontal, straight from shoulders to heels, legs together.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Bending the elbows
Hips piking or sagging out of line
Lowering past horizontal without control

summary: A gentle seated or standing stretch that lowers the chin toward the chest to release the muscles along the back of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head forward, bringing your chin toward your chest.
Clasp your hands lightly behind your head and let their weight add a gentle pull.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then release your hands and lift your head slowly.
cues: Let the hands rest, not yank

summary: A standing warm-up that circles straight arms backward to loosen the shoulders and raise upper-body temperature.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms by your sides.
Keeping your arms straight, raise them forward and up overhead.
Continue the circle back behind you and down to your sides.
Keep circling smoothly in the same direction, gradually increasing the size of the circles.
mistakes: Arching the lower back as the arms go overhead
Rushing into large, jerky circles

summary: A gentle shoulder mobility drill that rolls the shoulder joints backward with fingertips on the shoulders.
steps: Stand or sit tall and place your fingertips on your shoulders.
Lift your elbows forward and up.
Draw them back and down, tracing a circle with your elbows.
Keep circling backward at a moderate, even pace.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears
Moving the torso instead of the shoulders

summary: A crawl on hands and feet with hips raised that conditions the whole body and challenges the shoulders and core.
steps: Start on your hands and the balls of your feet with hips raised, like a high push-up position with hips higher.
Step forward with one hand and the opposite foot at the same time.
Repeat with the other hand and foot, moving in a steady crawling rhythm.
Keep moving for the set distance or time, then lower your knees to rest.
mistakes: Hips swaying side to side
Stepping same-side hand and foot together
Head hanging down

summary: A lying rotational mobility drill that crosses one bent knee over the body to open the hips and lower back while the shoulders stay down.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides and your legs straight.
Bend one knee and lift it toward your chest.
Rotate your hips to bring that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor, then return the knee to center and straighten the leg.
Alternate sides.
mistakes: Lifting the opposite shoulder off the floor
Forcing the knee down past a comfortable range

summary: A lying stretch that pulls one bent leg toward the chest to lengthen the hamstrings without straining the knee.
steps: Lie on your back with one leg straight on the floor.
Hold the other leg behind the thigh and draw it toward your chest, knee bent.
Pull gently until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh.
Keep your head and lower back on the floor.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing calmly, then switch sides.

summary: A leaning curl on suspension straps or rings that strengthens the biceps using your body weight.
steps: Hold the handles with palms facing up and walk your feet forward to lean back.
Straighten your arms so your body forms one straight line from head to heels.
Keeping your elbows high and in place, bend them to curl your hands toward your forehead.
Slowly straighten your arms to return to the start.
mistakes: Letting the elbows drop and turning it into a row
Hips sagging during the curl
Dropping back fast on the way down

summary: A plank-based core drill that drives one knee across to the opposite arm, training the abdominals and obliques under rotation.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands directly under your shoulders.
Lift one knee and drive it across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Round your lower back slightly as the knee comes through to engage the abs.
Return the foot to the plank and repeat with the other knee, alternating sides.
mistakes: Hips piking high to make room for the knee
Shoulders drifting behind the hands
Rushing so the plank loses shape

summary: A leaning underhand curl on a low bar that strengthens the biceps with body weight.
steps: Stand under a bar set around waist or chest height and grip it underhand, hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet forward and lean back with straight arms, body in a straight line.
Keeping your elbows high, bend them to curl your forehead toward the bar.
Lower yourself slowly back to straight arms.
mistakes: Dropping the elbows so it becomes a row
Hips sagging
Using a jerk to start the curl

summary: A forward step into a split stance and back that builds strength in the quadriceps and glutes and improves balance.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop when both knees are bent at about a right angle, front knee over the midfoot.
Push through the front foot to step back to standing.
Alternate legs or switch sides after the set.
mistakes: Front knee collapsing inward
Taking such a short step that the heel lifts
Slamming the back knee into the floor

summary: A pike push-up with the feet raised on a box that loads the shoulders and triceps more heavily, bridging toward the handstand push-up.
steps: Place your feet on a box and walk your hands back until your hips are high over your shoulders.
Set your hands about shoulder-width apart with your torso as vertical as you can manage.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor in front of your hands.
Press the floor away to straighten your arms and return to the top.
cues: Head forms a triangle with hands
mistakes: Elbows flaring straight out to the sides
Hips drifting back so it becomes a push-up
Dropping onto the head without control

summary: A squat to a box or bench that teaches you to sit back with control, strengthening the glutes and quadriceps.
steps: Stand in front of a sturdy box or bench, feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and sit your hips back and down, bending your knees.
Lower under control until your glutes lightly touch the box.
Pause briefly, then drive through your feet to stand tall.
mistakes: Dropping onto the box and relaxing
Rocking back to gain momentum to stand
Knees caving inward

summary: A side-lying stretch that combines a spinal twist with a quad stretch, opening the hips, thighs and upper back at once.
steps: Lie on one side with your head supported and both knees bent.
Bring your top knee forward to the floor and hold it down with your bottom hand.
Bend your bottom leg behind you and hold its foot with your top hand.
Gently rotate your chest and top shoulder toward the floor behind you.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch sides.

summary: A shuttle-run conditioning test with repeated sprints to markers at increasing distances, building speed endurance.
steps: Place markers at 20, 40 and 60 meters from a start line.
Sprint to the 20-meter marker and back to the start.
Without stopping, sprint to the 40-meter marker and back, then the 60-meter marker and back.
Continue the shuttle sequence for the set number of rounds as fast as you can.
cues: Low and quick at each turn
mistakes: Starting too fast and fading badly
Turning short of the marker
Turning upright instead of sinking the hips

summary: A kneeling stretch with the elbows on a bench that sinks the chest down to open the lats, triceps and upper back.
steps: Kneel facing a bench and rest your elbows on it, shoulder-width apart.
Bring your palms together and bend your elbows so your hands point back toward your head.
Walk your knees back and sink your chest toward the floor between your arms.
Keep your back long rather than rounded.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily.

summary: A sit-up done with the soles of the feet together and knees falling open, training the abdominals through a full range.
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out to the sides.
Reach your arms overhead along the floor.
Swing your arms forward and use your abs to curl up to sitting, reaching toward your feet.
Slowly roll back down one segment at a time to the start.
mistakes: Throwing the arms to yank the body up
Lifting the feet off the floor
Dropping back down quickly

summary: A face-down back extension with fingers laced behind the head that strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Lie face down with your legs straight and fingers interlaced behind your head.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your elbows as high as you can.
Raise your head and chest a little off the floor, keeping your neck long.
Pause briefly, then lower your chest and elbows under control.
mistakes: Pulling the head forward with the hands
Cranking the head back to look up
Lifting with the lower back only

summary: A hands-and-knees hold with the knees hovering and the upper back rounded, building core and shoulder endurance.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your toes and lift your knees just off the floor.
Push the floor away to round your upper back, like a cat arching.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Lifting the hips high into a downward-dog shape
Letting the shoulders sink between the hands
Holding the breath

summary: A dip with the hands on the edge of a chair that strengthens the triceps, front shoulders and chest.
steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair with hands beside your hips, fingers forward.
Slide your hips off the front with feet on the floor and arms straight.
Bend your elbows straight back to lower your body until they reach about a right angle.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and lift back up.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out to the sides
Hips drifting far from the chair
Dropping lower than the shoulders tolerate comfortably

summary: A neck posture drill that glides the head straight back to strengthen the deep neck flexors and align the head over the spine.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and eyes level.
Place two fingers on your chin.
Gently glide your head straight back, making a double chin, without tilting up or down.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, then relax forward.
mistakes: Tipping the chin down instead of gliding back
Pushing hard with the fingers

summary: A static hold at the top of an underhand pull-up that builds pulling strength in the lats and biceps.
steps: Grip the bar underhand with palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart.
Pull or jump up until your chin is at or above the bar.
Keep your shoulders down, core tight and legs still.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Craning the neck to reach the bar
Shrugging the shoulders up
Swinging or kicking the legs

summary: A side-lying hip drill that alternates opening the knee and lifting the foot, training the glutes through external and internal rotation.
steps: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent and legs stacked.
Lift your top knee slightly so the leg hovers above the bottom one.
Open the top knee upward, keeping the feet close together.
Then bring the knee down and lift the top foot up instead, rotating the hip inward.
Alternate slowly without resting the leg, then switch sides.
mistakes: Rolling the pelvis back to open the knee higher
Letting the top leg drop between reps

summary: A standing warm-up of rhythmic overhead claps that raises the heart rate and loosens the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms by your sides.
Swing your arms out and up to clap your hands overhead.
Lower your arms back to your sides under control.
Continue at a steady, rhythmic pace.
mistakes: Arching the lower back as the arms go up
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears

summary: A slow, gentle head-rolling drill in a clockwise direction that eases stiffness in the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward your right shoulder.
Roll it gently back to look slightly up, then toward your left shoulder.
Roll your chin down through the front and continue in one slow, fluid circle.
mistakes: Rolling quickly or forcing the end range
Dropping the head heavily backward

summary: A push-up with the hands close together that shifts the work toward the triceps while still training the chest.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands close together under your chest.
Brace so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows, keeping them close to your body, to lower your chest toward your hands.
Press the floor away to return to straight arms.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out wide
Hips sagging toward the floor
Cutting the range short

summary: A side plank with the top leg resting on a bench that strongly works the inner-thigh adductors along with the core.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and your top foot or ankle on a bench.
Let the bottom leg rest under the bench.
Press through the top leg and forearm to lift your hips until your body is in a straight line.
Lift the bottom leg up to meet the bench if you can.
Lower your hips under control, then switch sides.
mistakes: Hips sagging or piking
Rolling the torso forward or back
Letting the shoulder sink toward the ear

summary: A seated rotation with the feet raised that works the abdominals and obliques while building trunk control.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly with a long spine.
Lift your feet off the floor, balancing on your sit bones.
Rotate your torso to one side and touch the floor beside your hip with both hands.
Rotate through center to touch the floor on the other side, alternating smoothly.
mistakes: Rounding the back into a slump
Moving only the arms, not the torso
Rushing so the feet drop

summary: A slow, gentle head-rolling drill in a counterclockwise direction that eases stiffness in the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward your left shoulder.
Roll it gently back to look slightly up, then toward your right shoulder.
Roll your chin down through the front and continue in one slow, fluid circle.
mistakes: Rolling quickly or forcing the end range
Dropping the head heavily backward

summary: A standing or seated stretch that pulls one arm across the chest to lengthen the back of the shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall and extend one arm straight across your chest.
Hook your other forearm around the elbow of the extended arm.
Gently pull the arm closer to your chest while keeping that shoulder down.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

summary: A standing stretch that crosses one leg behind the other and folds forward to lengthen the hamstrings and outer hip.
steps: Stand tall and cross one leg behind the other, keeping the back leg straight.
Slightly bend the front knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach your hands down toward the toes of the back leg.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of the straight leg.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

summary: A standing dynamic warm-up that swings one leg across the body and out to the side to loosen the hips and inner thighs.
steps: Stand beside a wall or sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Swing the other leg across the front of your body, then back out to the side.
Keep swinging, gradually increasing the range, then switch sides.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to follow the leg
Swinging hard into the end range from the start

summary: A crunch performed with the legs raised straight up that targets the upper abdominals.
steps: Lie on your back and raise your legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Reach your arms up toward your toes.
Curl your head and shoulder blades off the floor, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Lower your shoulders back down slowly.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck
Letting the legs drift toward the floor
Bouncing off the floor

summary: A leg raise on a decline bench that trains the lower abdominals through a longer range than on flat ground.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your head at the high end and grip the handles or bench edge behind you.
Extend your legs and lift them slightly off the bench.
Using your abs, raise your legs toward the ceiling without swinging.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your legs slowly to just above the bench.
mistakes: Swinging the legs up
Letting the lower back arch as the legs lower
Resting the legs on the bench between reps

summary: A push-up with hands on raised blocks or handles so the chest lowers below hand level, increasing chest and shoulder range.
steps: Place two sturdy blocks or push-up handles shoulder-width apart and grip them in a high plank.
Brace so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest between your hands as far as you can control comfortably.
Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Hips sagging at the bottom
Dropping into the deep range quickly
Elbows flaring out wide

summary: A standing stretch with the hands clasped behind the back that opens the front of the shoulders and chest.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back with your arms straight.
Draw your shoulders back and gently lift your hands away from your body.
Keep your chest up and avoid leaning forward.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily.

summary: A full-range dip on parallel bars that builds strength in the chest, triceps and front shoulders.
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pressed down.
Lean your torso slightly forward and bend your elbows to lower your body.
Descend until your shoulders are just below your elbows, staying in control.
Press through your hands to straighten your arms back to the top.
mistakes: Dropping fast into the bottom
Shoulders rolling forward at the bottom
Swinging the legs to get back up

summary: A triceps dip with the hands on one bench and the heels on another, loading more body weight than a floor-supported bench dip.
steps: Set two benches apart so you can sit on the edge of one and rest your heels on the other.
Place your hands beside your hips, slide forward and support yourself with straight arms and legs.
Bend your elbows straight back to lower your hips toward the floor.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and lift back up.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out to the sides
Hips drifting away from the bench
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears

summary: A stretch with the forearm on a door frame that opens the chest and the front of the shoulder.
steps: Stand in a doorway and place one forearm vertically on the frame, elbow at about shoulder height.
Step forward with the same-side foot, keeping your arm still on the frame.
Turn your chest slightly away until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

summary: A lying core drill where hands and knees press against each other, building strong abdominal contraction without spinal movement.
steps: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent to 90 degrees in a tabletop position.
Place your hands on your thighs just above your knees.
Press your hands into your knees while using your abs to pull your knees toward your hands.
Hold the press briefly with your lower back on the floor, then release.
mistakes: Holding the breath during the press
Letting the lower back arch off the floor
Moving the legs instead of pressing

summary: A plank that jumps both feet in toward the hands and straight back out, building core and shoulder strength with power.
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under the shoulders and feet hip-width apart.
Brace so your body makes a straight line from head to heels.
Jump both feet in toward your hands, bending the knees.
As your feet land, jump them straight back out to the plank.
Keep the shoulders over the hands for every rep.
mistakes: Bending the elbows to find balance
Shoulders retracting so the chest sags
Jumping the feet up instead of leaning into the lift

summary: A side plank with slow hip dips that challenges the obliques and lateral core through a controlled range.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Lower your hips a few inches toward the floor without touching it.
Lift them back up in line, and keep dipping slowly for the set time, then switch sides.
mistakes: Rolling the torso forward or back
Dropping the hips to the floor
Sinking into the supporting shoulder

summary: A standing forward fold that alternately bends and straightens the knees to warm up and stretch the hamstrings and calves.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hinge forward, letting your hands reach toward the floor.
Bend one knee while keeping the other leg straight.
Smoothly switch, straightening the bent knee as you bend the other.
Keep alternating in a fluid, walking rhythm without lifting your feet.
mistakes: Locking the knees hard
Bouncing into the stretch

summary: A standing stretch with one heel on a raised support that lengthens the hamstrings of the elevated leg.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box, bench or bar at about hip height or lower.
Place one heel on it with the leg straight and toes pointing up.
Keep the standing leg straight and both hips square to the support.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch legs.

summary: A kneeling stretch with elbows on a bench and palms together that opens the lats, triceps and upper back.
steps: Kneel facing a bench and place your elbows on it, palms pressed together.
Walk your knees back until your hips are over or slightly behind your knees.
Exhale and let your chest sink toward the floor while bringing your hands toward the back of your shoulders.
Keep your lower back still and your neck relaxed.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily.

summary: A deep, body-weight-loaded stretch hanging from a bar that lengthens the lats, typically used after pulling work.
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your feet on a box (or the floor under a lower bar), bend your knees and sit your hips back until your arms are long overhead.
Relax your shoulders and let your body weight stretch your lats and armpits.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, then stand up to release.
mistakes: Losing grip and dropping suddenly
Forcing beyond a comfortable stretch

summary: A deep, body-weight-loaded stretch at the bottom of a push-up that lengthens the chest, typically used after chest work.
steps: Set two sturdy blocks or parallettes shoulder-width apart and support yourself in a plank or kneeling push-up.
Lower slowly until your chest sinks between your hands and you feel a stretch across the chest.
Relax into the bottom position, using your knees to take weight if needed.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, then press up or lower your knees to finish.
mistakes: Dropping into the bottom quickly
Shoulders rolling forward

summary: A deep, body-weight-loaded stretch for the front of the shoulders, typically used after pressing work.
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and hands behind you, fingers pointing away from your body.
Keep your arms straight and slowly walk your hips forward away from your hands.
Lift your chest and draw your shoulders back until you feel a stretch at the front of the shoulders.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, then walk your hips back to release.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears
Bending the elbows

summary: A support hold on top of a straight bar with the feet helping, building the shoulder and triceps strength for dips.
steps: Stand in front of a stable straight bar at about hip height and grip it with both hands.
Jump or press up so the bar is in front of your hips and your arms are straight.
Keep your feet on the floor or a platform to take some of your weight.
Press your shoulders down and hold steady without swinging.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears
Bending the elbows
Leaning so far forward the body tips over

summary: An advanced push-up on the fingertips that adds strong finger and hand strength demands to a standard chest press.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and fingers spread wide.
Lift your palms off the floor so your weight rests evenly on your fingertips and thumbs.
Brace your body in a straight line and lower your chest toward the floor.
Press through your fingertips to straighten your arms.
mistakes: Fingers collapsing flat
Hips sagging
Rushing the lowering phase

summary: An all-fours hip mobility drill that circles one bent leg out to the side to warm up the glutes and hip joint.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keeping the knee bent, lift one leg out to the side.
Draw slow circles with the knee, moving forward, out and back.
Reverse the direction of the circles, then switch sides.
mistakes: Shifting the torso away from the moving leg
Arching the lower back

summary: A dip from a seated position on the floor that strengthens the triceps, chest and front shoulders without equipment.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet flat and hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your hips.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows straight back to lower your hips toward the floor without touching it.
Straighten your arms to press back up.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out to the sides
Moving only the hips instead of bending the arms
Shrugging the shoulders

summary: A standing warm-up that circles straight arms forward to loosen the shoulders and raise upper-body temperature.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms by your sides.
Keeping your arms straight, swing them back behind you and up overhead.
Continue the circle forward and down to your sides.
Keep circling smoothly in the same direction, gradually increasing the size of the circles.
mistakes: Arching the lower back as the arms go overhead
Rushing into large, jerky circles

summary: A gentle shoulder mobility drill that rolls the shoulder joints forward with fingertips on the shoulders.
steps: Stand or sit tall and place your fingertips on your shoulders.
Lift your elbows back and up.
Bring them forward and down, tracing a circle with your elbows.
Keep circling forward at a moderate, even pace.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears
Moving the torso instead of the shoulders

summary: An elite lever variation that pulls the chest toward the bar while holding the body horizontal, demanding great lat and core strength.
steps: Hang from a bar and raise your body into a front lever, tucked or with legs straight.
Keeping your body horizontal, pull your chest toward the bar.
Hold the top position briefly with your shoulders down and hips level.
Lower back to a straight-arm lever under control, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Hips dropping as you pull
Turning it into a regular pull-up
Bending at the hips to cheat the lever

summary: A gentle stretch that tilts the head back to lengthen the muscles along the front of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back, supporting the back of your head with your hands if needed.
Gently close your mouth and press your lower jaw upward to feel a stretch at the front of the neck.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then slowly return your head to neutral.

summary: A dynamic plank variation that rotates the body to thread one leg under, training the core, shoulders and hips together.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Shift your weight to one hand and rotate your body toward the other side.
Bend the leg on that side behind you, tap the foot down and reach the free arm up.
Return through center to the plank and repeat on the opposite side, alternating.
mistakes: Sinking into the supporting shoulder
Dropping the hips during the rotation
Rushing so control is lost

summary: A bodyweight hip hinge that bows the torso forward with a flat back, training the hamstrings, glutes and spinal control.
steps: Stand with feet a little wider than shoulder-width and hands on your hips or behind your head.
Soften your knees and push your hips back as your torso tips forward.
Keep your back flat and lower until you feel tension in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
mistakes: Rounding the back
Bending the knees into a squat
Leaning back at the top

summary: A lying hamstring mobility drill that holds the thigh close and straightens the knee to lengthen the back of the leg.
steps: Lie on your back and bend one knee toward your chest.
Clasp your hands behind that thigh and pull it gently toward you.
Slowly straighten the knee, extending the foot toward the ceiling until you feel a stretch.
Bend the knee to release, then repeat before switching sides.
mistakes: Letting the thigh drift away as the knee straightens
Lifting the hips off the floor

summary: A walking or standing warm-up that kicks a straight leg up toward the opposite hand to loosen the hamstrings and hips.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and extend one arm in front of you at shoulder height.
Swing the opposite leg up toward your hand, keeping the leg straight and toes up.
Lower the leg under control and step forward or return to standing.
Repeat with the other leg and arm, alternating.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach the leg
Forcing the kick higher than the hamstrings allow

summary: An advanced hanging leg raise on rings that adds a pelvic tuck and hip lift, strongly training the lower abdominals.
steps: Hang from rings with straight arms and shoulders drawn down.
Tilt your pelvis back to engage your abs before lifting.
Raise your straight legs and continue by lifting your hips toward the rings.
Lower your hips and legs slowly under control, without swinging.
mistakes: Swinging to generate momentum
Bending the knees to cheat the lift
Dropping the legs quickly

summary: A lying hip-opening stretch holding the feet with knees drawn toward the armpits, relaxing the glutes, inner thighs and lower back.
steps: Lie on your back and draw your knees toward your armpits.
Hold the outside of your feet, ankles or shins with the soles facing the ceiling.
Keep your shins roughly vertical and gently pull your knees down toward the floor.
Keep your head and lower back on the floor; you may rock gently side to side.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing calmly.

summary: A gentle neck stretch that tilts the head toward each shoulder to lengthen the muscles on the side of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head to bring one ear toward your shoulder.
Hold briefly, then return your head to center.
Tilt your head to the other side and hold, then return to center.

summary: A gentle neck mobility drill that turns the head to each side and holds, improving rotation range.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Hold briefly at the end of the range, then return to center.
Turn to the other side and hold, then return to center.

summary: A springy skipping drill that drives the knees high, raising the heart rate and building rhythm and leg power.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Skip forward or in place, driving one knee up toward hip height.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee drive.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and alternate legs in a quick rhythm.
mistakes: Leaning back as the knees rise
Landing heavily on the heels

summary: A lying twist that lowers both bent knees side to side to loosen the hips, glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides, knees bent and together, feet on the floor.
Slowly lower both knees to one side, keeping your shoulders and arms on the floor.
Pause briefly, then bring the knees back to the centre.
Lower them to the other side and keep alternating.

summary: A half-kneeling stretch that pushes the hips forward to lengthen the hip flexors and the front of the thigh.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, hands on your hips.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis slightly under.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

summary: A standing wall stretch with the arm out to the side that opens the chest and front of the shoulder.
steps: Stand beside a wall or doorway and place your hand on it at shoulder height, arm straight.
Keep your shoulder down and back.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.
cues: Turn the body, not the arm

summary: A static hold at the top of an inverted row under a low bar, building pulling strength in the upper back and arms.
steps: Lie under a bar set around waist height and grip it slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Straighten your body from head to heels with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Hips sagging toward the floor
Shrugging the shoulders
Reaching with the chin instead of the chest

summary: A wide, deep squat hold with the toes turned out that opens the hips and inner thighs while working the glutes.
steps: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned slightly out.
Sink into a deep, wide squat with your hips at or below knee level.
Keep your chest up and press your knees out in line with your toes.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, then stand up under control.
mistakes: Knees caving inward
Rounding the back to get lower
Heels lifting

summary: A crunch on an inclined bench with the feet anchored, working the abdominals through a larger range than a flat crunch.
steps: Lie back on an incline bench with your feet secured under the pads and your arms crossed over your chest.
Curl your upper body up by rolling your spine off the bench.
Continue until your chest approaches your knees.
Roll back down slowly, one segment at a time.
mistakes: Tucking the chin hard into the chest
Using momentum to swing up
Dropping back onto the bench

summary: A feet-elevated plank in which one foot at a time taps the floor beside the support, challenging core stability.
steps: Set up in a forearm or high plank with both feet on a bench or ball behind you.
Brace your body into a straight line from head to heels.
Slowly move one foot sideways off the support and touch it to the floor.
Return the foot to the support, then repeat with the other foot, alternating.
mistakes: Hips rotating as the foot lowers
Hips sagging
Rushing the foot movement

summary: A row on gymnastic rings with the body inclined at an angle, building upper-back and biceps strength with adjustable difficulty.
steps: Grip the rings and walk your feet forward until your body leans back at an angle.
Straighten your body from head to heels with arms extended.
Pull your chest up to the rings, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly back to straight arms; walk your feet forward to make it harder.
mistakes: Hips sagging during the pull
Shrugging the shoulders
Letting the rings drift wide

summary: A straight-arm shoulder blade drill on an incline that trains the serratus and upper back to move the shoulder blades well.
steps: Place your hands on a bench in an incline push-up position, arms straight.
Push your chest away from the bench to spread your shoulder blades apart.
Keeping your elbows straight, let your chest sink so the shoulder blades pinch together.
Push the bench away again to spread the shoulder blades.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a push-up
Sagging the hips
Shrugging toward the ears

summary: A static bodyweight squat held as long as you can maintain good form, building endurance in the quadriceps and glutes.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat, thighs about parallel to the floor or higher.
Keep your chest up, weight across your whole foot and knees in line with your toes.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, until you can no longer keep good form.
mistakes: Knees caving inward as you fatigue
Rising slowly out of the position without noticing
Holding the breath

summary: A pull-up assisted by a jump from the floor, followed by a slow lowering, that builds strength toward full pull-ups.
steps: Stand under a bar on the floor or a low box so you can reach it with bent arms.
Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Jump and pull at the same time until your chin passes the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can to straight arms.
mistakes: Dropping quickly from the top
Relying on the jump with no pull
Shrugging at the top

summary: A lying stretch that draws one knee to the chest to ease the lower back and glutes and improve hip mobility.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Bend one knee and draw it toward your chest, holding behind the thigh or on the shin.
Gently pull the knee closer while keeping the other leg relaxed on the floor.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

summary: A kneeling hip extension that pushes one foot back and up, targeting the glutes.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core to keep your back flat.
Push one foot back until the leg is extended, squeezing the glute.
Pause briefly, then return the knee under the hip; alternate legs.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to lift higher
Rotating the hip open
Swinging the leg with momentum

summary: A kneeling opposite arm-and-leg reach that strengthens the back extensors, glutes and shoulders while training trunk stability.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg straight back with the foot pushing long behind you.
At the same time, reach the opposite arm forward with your shoulder held high.
Hold briefly with hips level, then return and switch sides.
mistakes: Arching the lower back
Rotating the hips toward the lifted leg
Rushing between sides

summary: A straight-arm support hold with legs extended in front at hip height, demanding strong abdominals, hip flexors and triceps.
steps: Sit with your legs straight and place your hands on the floor or parallettes beside your hips.
Press down to straighten your arms and push your shoulders down.
Lift your hips and legs off the floor, keeping the legs straight and together.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up
Bending the knees
Leaning far back to balance

summary: An L-sit with the heels lightly resting on the floor, building the support strength and compression needed for a full L-sit.
steps: Sit with your legs straight and hands on the floor or parallettes beside your hips.
Press down to straighten your arms and lift your hips off the floor.
Keep your legs straight with the heels touching the floor to take some weight.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Letting the heels take most of the weight
Shrugging the shoulders
Bending the elbows

summary: A side-to-side hop that pushes off one leg and lands on the other, building lateral power, balance and calf strength.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and hip.
Push off sideways and jump to land on the other leg.
Land softly, bending the knee and hip, and regain your balance.
Push off back to the first leg and continue alternating.
mistakes: Landing with a stiff, straight knee
Knee collapsing inward on landing
Hopping again before you are balanced

summary: A sideways walk in a half-squat that strengthens the hip abductors and glutes.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and bend into a shallow squat.
Step one foot out to the side, keeping your hips level.
Bring the other foot in to return to hip-width, staying in the squat.
Continue for the set distance, then walk back the other way.
mistakes: Standing up between steps
Bringing the feet together completely
Rocking the torso side to side

summary: A seated or standing stretch for the left side of the neck that targets the muscle running from the neck to the shoulder blade.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your left arm relaxed by your side or behind your back.
Turn your head about halfway to the right and look down toward your right armpit.
Place your right hand on the back of your head and let it add a light pull.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then slowly lift your head to release.

summary: A gentle side neck stretch for the left side, lengthening the muscles between the left ear and shoulder.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Rest your right hand on the left side of your head to add a light pull if needed.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then slowly bring your head back to center.

summary: A two-position kneeling stretch that opens the hip flexors and quadriceps, then the hamstrings, to relieve lower-body tension.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front in a low lunge.
Shift your hips forward gently to stretch the front of the back hip and thigh, and hold.
Shift your hips back over the back knee and straighten the front leg, toes up.
Hinge forward with a flat back to stretch the hamstrings of the front leg, and hold.
Hold each position 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

summary: A lying core drill that circles the raised legs in small arcs, challenging the abdominals to keep the lower back pressed down.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and raise your legs straight up, knees together.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw small, slow circles with your legs in one direction.
Reverse the direction, keeping the circles small and the back down.
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor
Circles too large to control
Swinging with momentum

summary: A crunch with a held pause at the top that keeps the upper abdominals working without the lower body moving.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulder blades off the floor without moving your hips.
Pause and hold the top for a count or two.
Lower your shoulders back down slowly.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck
Using momentum to rise
Dropping down without control

summary: A low lunge with a torso twist toward the front leg that stretches the hip flexors while opening the upper back.
steps: Step into a low lunge with your back knee on the floor and front knee over the ankle.
Place the hand opposite the front leg on the floor or front thigh.
Rotate your chest toward the front leg and reach the other arm up toward the ceiling.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily, then switch sides.

summary: A lying stretch with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee that lengthens the glutes and outer hip.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to form a figure four.
Reach through and hold the back of the lower thigh or its shin.
Gently pull the legs toward your chest until you feel a stretch in the glute of the crossed leg.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

summary: A low-impact rhythmic march or jog in place that warms up the body and builds endurance in a small space.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
March in place, lifting your knees and swinging your arms naturally.
Increase the pace to a light jog in place if you want more intensity.
Keep a steady rhythm and land softly on the balls of your feet.
mistakes: Leaning forward or slouching
Landing heavily on the heels

summary: A controlled standing march that lifts each knee high to warm up the hip flexors and legs and practice upright posture.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Lift one knee toward your chest as high as is comfortable.
Swing the opposite arm forward as the knee rises.
Lower the foot and repeat with the other leg, alternating in a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Leaning back to lift the knee higher
Rushing so the rhythm is lost

summary: Slow, controlled full circles of the head that move the neck through its active range to maintain mobility.
steps: Sit or stand tall and gently brace your trunk so only your neck moves.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Slowly roll your head toward one shoulder, back, to the other shoulder and down again.
Keep the circles slow and controlled, then reverse direction.
mistakes: Moving the shoulders or torso with the head
Rushing through the circle

summary: A gentle neck mobility drill that rolls the head in a half circle across the front, from shoulder to shoulder.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward one shoulder.
Slowly roll your chin down across your chest toward the other shoulder.
Roll back across the front and continue moving side to side.
mistakes: Rolling the head backward
Lifting the shoulders to meet the ears

summary: A pull-up with the palms facing each other that builds lat and biceps strength in a shoulder-friendly grip.
steps: Hang from parallel handles with palms facing each other and arms straight.
Draw your shoulders down and brace your core with legs together.
Pull your chest toward the handles until your chin passes them.
Lower yourself under control to straight arms.
mistakes: Kicking or swinging to get up
Cutting the range short at the bottom
Reaching with the chin

summary: A side-lying rotation that opens the top arm like a book, improving upper-back rotation and opening the chest.
steps: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent to about 90 degrees and arms straight out in front, palms together.
Keep your knees stacked on the floor.
Inhale and sweep the top arm up and over, rotating your upper back to open toward the other side.
Let your eyes follow your hand, then exhale and return the arm slowly.
Switch sides.
mistakes: Letting the knees or hips roll back
Forcing the arm to the floor

summary: A straight-arm support hold on parallel bars that builds shoulder stability and triceps strength for dips.
steps: Stand between parallel bars and grip them with your knuckles facing outward.
Press down to straighten your arms and lift your feet off the floor.
Push your shoulders down away from your ears and keep your body still.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up
Bending the elbows
Swinging the legs
